The beetle exhibits a metallic reddish-bronze and green coloration with distinct pale cream-colored markings on its elytra. It has long, slender legs with visible joints, prominent compound eyes, and long filiform antennae. The lighting creates strong highlights on the exoskeleton, emphasizing its iridescent texture.
